newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand waives tax to promote shipping industry.
newsitem.headline: Thailand waives tax to promote shipping industry.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday decided to waive 30 percent corporate tax on domestic shipping operators, a government official said.
The move was aimed at promoting Thailand's commercial fleet and reducing the country's dependence on foreign shipping, thereby lowering the national current account deficit.
"The tax removal will encourage Thai shipping companies to register their ships in Thailand," deputy transport and communications minister Pinij Jarusombat told reporters.
He said most Thai vessels had been registered in Singapore and Panama.

Pinij said freight charges paid by Thai exporters to foreign shippers to transport goods overseas in 1995 totalled nearly 20 billion baht, or seven percent of the country's total payments for services.
He expected about 2.2 million dead weight tonnes of shipments to move to register in Thailand after the government's decision today. -- Bangkok newsroom (662) 652-0642 REUTER
